description:
We are SPACE BOYS, a team from Shivamogga, India, creating an interactive space-learning experience for young explorers. Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, helps students explore the choices behind a space mission through hands-on gameplay—from building a rocket to keeping a lunar outpost supplied and its crew safe.

Our goal is to make space science engaging, understandable, and fun, encouraging students to experiment, learn from mistakes, and try again.
summary:
SPACE BOYZ – MARS ROVER TRAINING

Created by: Charvik P N and Harshal G R

SPACE BOYS is an interactive space exploration game developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It allows players to experience a simulated Mars rover mission. Players can explore the Martian surface, drive the rover, collect five scientific samples and complete different missions.

The game includes three mission modes: Mars Rover Exploration, Mountain Expedition and Mars Dust Storm. Players can control rover movement, turn in different directions and use headlights. The mission dashboard displays important information such as speed, distance, battery level and system status.

We developed this browser-based project using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It combines entertainment with education and introduces students to planetary exploration in an engaging way.

The project encourages curiosity, creativity, logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Its creative approach is to transform Mars exploration into an interactive gaming experience with different environments, missions and rover controls.

During development, we considered easy controls, attractive design, student-friendly gameplay, mission objectives and an enjoyable learning experience.

Our goal is to inspire young students to learn about space science, explore new worlds and develop an interest in future space missions.
details:
SPACE BOYS – MARS ROVER TRAINING

NASA SPACE APPS CHALLENGE 2026
Created by: Charvik P N and Harshal G R

Our project, SPACE BOYS – Mars Rover Training, is an interactive space exploration game that gives players an experience of driving a rover on Mars. Players can explore the Martian surface, complete missions and collect five scientific samples using the rover.

The game includes three mission modes: Mars Rover Exploration, Mountain Expedition and Mars Dust Storm. Players can drive forward, reverse, turn left and right, collect samples, and switch on the headlights. The mission dashboard displays rover speed, distance, battery level and system status. Players can also pause and resume the mission.

We developed this browser-based game using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It is designed to make space exploration enjoyable and introduce students to rover navigation and planetary missions.

The project's benefits include improving curiosity, logical thinking, decision-making and problem-solving skills. It encourages students to learn about Mars exploration through interactive gameplay.

Our creative approach is to combine gaming with space science by providing different missions, rover controls and a mission telemetry dashboard. While developing the project, we considered easy controls, student-friendly design, mission objectives, battery management and an engaging experience.

Our goal is to inspire young learners to explore space science and become interested in future space missions.
